statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring CPT 93229 is ordered
The procedure is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The procedure is ordered to guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
